selected_evidence.requirement: Streaming replication established: node1 primary, node2/node3 standbys
selected_evidence.summary: node1 started as primary; replicator role created; basebackups taken on node2/node3 with standby.signal; pg_stat_replication shows both streaming; canary row present on both standbys

selected_evidence.requirement: Failover: standby takes over as writable primary without losing committed data
selected_evidence.summary: Committed row inserted on node1 and confirmed on both standbys pre-disruption; node1 stopped; node2 promoted via pg_promote(); post-promotion query on node2 shows both prior rows present plus a new successful write

selected_evidence.requirement: Surviving standby (node3) re-pointed to new primary (node2)
selected_evidence.summary: node3 primary_conninfo altered to node2 and restarted; pg_stat_replication on node2 shows node3 streaming; node3 data matches node2 including the post-failover write

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary (node1) rejoins as standby of current primary (node2)
selected_evidence.summary: node1 data directory rebuilt via pg_basebackup from node2 with -R; node1 started in recovery; node2's pg_stat_replication shows both node1 and node3 streaming; node1 data matches cluster

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart: node1 baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0581c914... and standby health captured; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 29f0dc22... confirms restart; postgresql active, in recovery, canary data intact, and node2 sees node1 streaming again

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart: node3 baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 96974ac3... captured; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id c39f6231... confirms restart; postgresql active, in recovery, canary data intact, and node2 shows both standbys streaming

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart: node2 (primary) baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 83a0a80f... and primary/replication health captured; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 06554069... confirms restart; postgresql active and out of recovery (still primary) with intact data; both node1 and node3 reconnected as streaming standbys
